title: TAMIU Planetarium Offers Thanksgiving Showtimes Nov. 23-25
excerpt: Texas A&M International University's Lamar Bruni Vergara Planetarium is running special Thanksgiving showtimes Monday, Nov. 23 through Wednesday, Nov. 25, with three shows each day and tickets at the door.
content:
Texas A&M International University's Lamar Bruni Vergara Planetarium is running special Thanksgiving showtimes Monday, Nov. 23 through Wednesday, Nov. 25.

The same three shows run each day: The Great Solar System Adventure at 10:00 a.m., Chemistry of Life at 1:30 p.m., and Orbital at 3:30 p.m.

Tickets are available at the door. The planetarium announced the holiday schedule on its Facebook page Tuesday, Nov. 24.
